# BrandKlout

BrandKlout is a dental-first market authority and growth company. It helps dental practices become easier to find, trust and choose across Google, AI-assisted search, online reputation, conversion websites, paid acquisition, local SEO and Lead to Collection.

## Core pages
- /solutions.html — connected growth system
- /specialties.html — treatment and specialty-specific strategies
- /customer-stories.html — reported client-period evidence
- /market-opportunity.html — free market opportunity map
- /authority-score.html — 21-question yes/no assessment: Online Reputation, SEO & AI Search, and Marketing Performance

## Important claims policy
BrandKlout does not promise specific search rankings or AI recommendations. Customer-story metrics reflect specific reported client periods and individual results vary.

- /ai-search-authority.html
- /reputation-engine.html
- /ai-growth-engine.html
- /conversion-websites.html
